column2: #add leading zeroes to tag ID on a case-by-case basis (check fish comments)
#check for tag ID's with less than 4 digits
#if no recorded PIT tag number or tagging status,
#assign tagging status to "No tag will be applied"
mutate(tag_status = case_when(is.na(tag_id_short) & species %in% c("Chinook", "Coho") & is.na(tag_status) ~ "no_tag", TRUE ~ tag_status))
#From manual QC - multiple PIT scanners used on one day
filter(grepl("pit scan", day_comments, ignore.case = TRUE) | grepl("pit scan", set_comments, ignore.case = TRUE) | grepl("pit scan", fish_comments, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
#there's a couple instances of this - resolved below
#retrieve set IDs for sets where the scanner used was different than in day comments
#Correct tags to the correct scanner on a case-by-case basis
filter(grepl("pit scan", day_comments, ignore.case = TRUE) | grepl("pit scan", set_comments, ignore.case = TRUE) | grepl("pit scan", fish_comments, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
